newsitem.title: USA: CalPERS board names Gillan as its general counsel.
newsitem.headline: CalPERS board names Gillan as its general counsel.

text.p: The California Public Employees' Retirement System (CalPERS) Board of Administration said on Tuesday it appointed Kayla Gillan as general counsel.
Gillan joined the CalPERS legal staff in 1986, serving as deputy general counsel since 1990.

As general counsel, Gillan will manage the CalPERS legal office and serve as legal adviser to the Board of Administration and executive staff on pension and trust law, tax law, health care, investments and corporate governance.

Gillan will also coordinate the system's corporate governance program. The program works with companies in which the system owns stock to develop corporate policies that promote independent boards of directors and other policies that allow shareholder input.
Gillan replaced Richard Koppes, who recently retired from state service to join private industry.

CalPERS is the largest public pension fund in the U.S. with more than $100 billion in assets. The system manages retirement and health benefits for more than one million California public employees and their families.
